text: The initiative involves the procurement of servers for the National Multi-Hazard Early Warning Centre (N-EWC) in Papua New Guinea, under the Building Safety and Resilience in the Pacific Phase II (BSRP II) program led by the Pacific Community's Geoscience, Energy and Maritime (GEM) Division. It aims to establish and operationalize a national multi-hazard early warning capability through the provisioning of core ICT infrastructure and staffing, including the appointment of a National Multi-Hazard Early Warning Centre Coordinator.

metadata.solution_name: Equipment procurement for the Papua New Guinea National Multi-Hazard Early Warning Centre (N-EWC)
